fine_lines.title: free (adjective) vs freedom (noun)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: إضافة لاحقة الاسم تغيّر نوع الكلمة: free صفة، و freedom اسم.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Adding a noun suffix changes the word class: "free" is an adjective, "freedom" is a noun.

fine_lines.title: damage (noun/verb) vs damaged (adjective)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: damage اسم (الضرر) أو فعل (يُتلف). damaged صفة تصف حالة الشيء بعد التلف.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Damage" is a noun (the harm) or a verb (to harm). "Damaged" is an adjective for the condition after.

expressions.example: Did you get any footage of the match?

expressions.meaning_en: an event where someone joins an honoured group
expressions.example: The induction ceremony is next Friday.

grammar.title: Noun suffixes that show action
grammar.explanation_ar: اللواحق -ism و -age و -tion/-ion و -dom تصنع أسماء، ومعناها العام "فعل" أو "حالة". معرفة اللاحقة تساعدك على فهم الكلمات الجديدة في القراءة الأكاديمية والصحف.
grammar.explanation_en: The suffixes -ism, -age, -tion/-ion and -dom make nouns, usually with a meaning of action or condition. Knowing them helps you guess new words in academic reading and newspapers.

grammar.title: -ism: belief, profession, action
grammar.explanation_ar: -ism قد تعني معتقدًا أو نظامًا (capitalism)، أو مهنة (journalism)، أو فعلًا.
grammar.explanation_en: -ism can mean a belief or system (capitalism), a profession (journalism), or an action.

grammar.title: -age: action, group, condition
grammar.explanation_ar: -age قد تعني فعلًا (damage = يُتلف)، أو مجموعة (footage = لقطات مصورة)، أو حالة (damaged = تالف).
grammar.explanation_en: -age can mean an action (to damage), a group (footage = recorded film), or a condition (damaged).
examples: We have ten minutes of footage.

grammar.title: -tion / -ion: action (or condition)
grammar.explanation_ar: -tion / -ion تدل غالبًا على فعل: produce → production، induct → induction، reproduce → reproduction.
grammar.explanation_en: -tion / -ion usually shows an action: produce → production, induct → induction, reproduce → reproduction.
examples: This is a reproduction of a famous painting.

grammar.title: -dom: condition or field of interest
grammar.explanation_ar: -dom تدل على حالة أو مجال اهتمام: free → freedom، king → kingdom.
grammar.explanation_en: -dom shows a condition or a field of interest: free → freedom, king → kingdom.
